principle: RS-05: past-paper frequency may calibrate emphasis but MUST NOT remove or weaken syllabus-mandated coverage. Exposure is evidence metadata, never a priority ranking. Every mandatory objective is covered whatever its exposure; what changes is the TYPE of item, not whether items exist.
why_silence_is_weak_evidence: Roughly 165 question parts a year against 258 assessable objectives. Most objectives cannot appear in any given year, so six years of silence is the default state for a mandatory objective rather than a signal about it. Two further reasons to hedge: syllabus v2 is first examined in 2026, so the question bank is being rewritten; and boards rotate coverage deliberately to stay unpredictable.

classes.probed_high: Named in a stem and reaching 8 marks or more. Gets DEF, APP, CHAIN and EVAL - 4 items.
classes.probed_low: Named but capped at 5 marks or fewer. A 3-mark ceiling really does mean one card. 1 item.
classes.unprobed_2020_2025: Never named in six years, high-confidence match pattern. Coverage floor applies: DEF and DIST - 2 items - plus inclusion in synoptic mixed practice and the 'rarely-examined' review set. Not down-weighted below the floor.
classes.unmeasured_homonym_risk: Match pattern is a common English word, so the probe cannot distinguish a real hit from a homonym. Treated as unprobed and given the same floor. Resolve by hand at Stage 13.
classes.unmeasured_bullet_level: Unsplit bullet. The probe measured member naming only; bullet exposure awaits mark-scheme mining.

review_set_rarely_examined.rule: A filtered view over the single item bank, not a separate chapter and not a duplicate bank - RS-26 permits base and extension banks only as metadata or filtered views.
review_set_rarely_examined.membership: Every objective classed unprobed_2020_2025 or unmeasured_homonym_risk.
review_set_rarely_examined.learner_framing: Rarely examined - know these. Deliberate mastery at the same depth as everything else; these objectives are flagged so a learner notices them, not so they get less practice.
review_set_rarely_examined.ao_emphasis: AO1 and AO2 first for this set. You cannot evaluate what you cannot define, and 12-mark evaluation practice is the scarcest resource in a 700-item budget. AO3 and AO4 exposure comes through shared synoptic items rather than private EVAL cards.
review_set_rarely_examined.annual_review: Re-run the granularity probe each year against the new series. A concept that appears promotes out of this set automatically.
review_set_rarely_examined.drill_volume_note: Corrected 2026-09-08 after review issue SR-9609-5.2-CODEX-R2-004: 'lower drill volume' contradicted this artifact's own principle that exposure changes item type, never item presence or depth.

structural_absence_caveat: Not every absence is rotational. The integration taxonomy - horizontal, vertical, conglomerate - returns zero hits in 988 AS parts but is core to A Level topic 6 business strategy. It is plausibly absent at AS because Cambridge examines it later. Know it cold; do not spend evaluation practice on it.
